scope: Owned whitelist/account fixtures and real ephemeral signatures only. The historical relayer key is never replaced, signer privileges are never invented, and all cases must reject before business success. The earlier manual control may differ; all its differences remain recorded. Original/candidate comparison is mandatory. Frozen comparator and normal signature/blockhash/history checks remain enabled.
